objective: Implement deterministic fail-closed execution-time spread, displayed-liquidity and capacity checks using canonical P09-D/P09-E microstructure outputs and explicit governed thresholds, without hidden-liquidity, slippage, fillability or execution claims.
scope: Require OrderBookMetrics and LiquidityHeatmapSnapshot to share the same source snapshot
Apply explicit governed maximum spread basis points
Select an explicit governed liquidity distance band
Use side-aware cumulative displayed notional capacity: asks for LONG and bids for SHORT
Compute requested-notional to displayed-capacity utilization with conservative ceiling basis-point arithmetic
Apply explicit governed maximum displayed-capacity utilization
Fail closed on missing capacity band, malformed/zero displayed capacity or inconsistent microstructure inputs
Emit deterministic PRETRADE_D_ELIGIBLE or VETO decisions
tests: LONG uses displayed ask notional and SHORT uses displayed bid notional
Capacity utilization above explicit maximum vetoes
Capacity utilization uses conservative ceiling arithmetic
P16-D evidence is byte-identical across two runs
rollback: Revert P16-D module/config/tests/evidence/CI/state changes; P16-C remains canonical complete and P16-E remains unstarted.
definition_of_ready: No active governed task or lock conflict
definition_of_done: No prohibited liquidity claims or execution authority
Strict CI and deterministic evidence pass
